route_scope: Source-bound work-local route only; no candidate generation, CVW admission, integration, acceptance, rights, release, or publication.
required_checks: Verify the exact retained member path, byte length, SHA-256, ThML root, and all 25 ordered direct div1 carriers against the work-local selection.
Independently enumerate every selected element and compare source path, native id, source tag, and exact source attributes with source-accountability.features.
Verify deterministic one-to-one TEI xml:id mapping, source preorder, element mapping, exact text/tail values, child order, comments, and TEI P5 schema validity.
Verify each scripCom as an empty TEI milestone in source order with unit=scripCom, the original type, passage n, and OSIS corresp; verify ol as an ordered TEI list with its two source items in order.
Verify the complete document shell, direct-body comment accounting, source-envelope census, original source hash binding, and unresolved question set.
Reject omission, duplication, reordering, source-accountability drift, or mutation of either custom mapping.
source_attributes: Full original attribute names and values remain in source-accountability.features even when represented through a TEI attribute or retained only in accounting.
identity_and_rights: Header metadata remains source evidence. No unsupported work/part/form/edition/witness claim, print date, rights clearance, human acceptance, release, or publication claim may be added.
determinism: The producer returns exactly the five non-manifest package members and must produce byte-identical in-memory members for unchanged authorities.
integration_boundary: The shared reconstruction contract may consume the work-specific callable, but coordinator-owned candidate generation, package sealing, CVW, and integration are not part of this slice.
